ready.feedback_good: Athletic ready position with balanced base.
ready.feedback_bad: Weight is drifting — widen the base and stay on the balls of your feet.
ready.ideal: Knees flexed, racquet in front, weight centered.

unit_turn.feedback_good: Clean unit turn loading the back hip.
unit_turn.feedback_bad: Unit turn is shallow — turn shoulders and hips together earlier.
unit_turn.ideal: Shoulders and hips co-rotate away from the target.

takeback.feedback_good: Full takeback creating space to accelerate.
takeback.feedback_bad: Backswing is short — take the racquet further back for racquet-head speed.
takeback.ideal: Hitting hand reaches behind the back hip line.

racquet_drop.feedback_good: Racquet drops into the slot under the ball.
racquet_drop.feedback_bad: Missing the slot — let the racquet head drop below the hand before accelerating.
racquet_drop.ideal: Racquet head below the hand, tip pointing down.

acceleration.feedback_bad: Acceleration is late or muted — start the forward swing earlier from the drop.
acceleration.ideal: Continuous speed build from drop through contact.

contact.feedback_good: Contact height is in the strike zone out in front.
contact.feedback_bad: Contact point is off — meet the ball out in front at waist-to-chest height.
contact.ideal: Contact in front of the front hip, waist to mid-chest.

extension.feedback_good: Full extension through the hitting zone.
extension.feedback_bad: Arm collapses after contact — drive through toward the target.
extension.ideal: Arm extends toward the target after contact.

finish.feedback_good: High finish over the opposite shoulder.
finish.feedback_bad: Finish is low — wrap the racquet over the opposite shoulder.
finish.ideal: Racquet finishes over the non-hitting shoulder.
